fills.name: Three Loch Lookout
fills.quote: The number of warriors received from mustering is increased by 75%.
fills.tieReason: Both numbers are clearly shown: the Three Loch Lookout card (Age IV Military Landmark, Highlands; 2400 food, 1200 gold, 4m 10s) says it 'adds 3 muster charges for the Mustering Hall or Three Loch Lookout' and 'the number of warriors received from mustering is increased by 75%'. The video overlay repeats this as '+3 MUSTER CHARGES · +75% WARRIORS'. Neither reader misread anything. The landmark has two separate effects, and a single effectValue cannot hold both without guessing which one the field means. Record them as two fields: muster charges +3 and warriors from mustering +75%.

fills.name: Highland Cattle grazing
fills.quote: produce Food at a rate of 30 per minute
fills.note: The tooltip gives a rate of 30 food per minute, not a tick interval
fills.tieReason: The Scots overview (Unique Units > Highland Cattle) says only 'While eating they produce Food at a rate of 30 per minute'. That is a rate (30 food per 60 s). It does not give a tick interval, and none of the frames shows one. Reader A's 60 turns 'per minute' into an interval, which the frame does not state. Record the rate as 30 food/min instead.
